notes:
Background: mid-market analytics SaaS (B2B) — product team wants in-app assistant + smarter search. Started with Hosted API exploration; strong preference to move to Dedicated once residency + latency validated.

Key quotes: "We need EU-only storage for vectors and logs"; "40-60ms tail latency for chat in EU is our target". CTO: Johan Meyer; emphasized procurement timeline end of Q2.

POC approach agreed: 1) short Hosted API pilot (2 weeks) to validate prompts + metrics; 2) Dedicated baseline POC in eu-west to validate residency & private link. Team will run A/B between hosted (eu region) and dedicated (single-region) to measure 95th pct latency and cost/req.

Security ask: DPA + processing addendum, SSO (SAML) integration, SOC2 and audit log export cadence. Legal already requested encryption-at-rest details and KMS options.

Cost sensitivity: unit cost per 1k tokens important — wants model profiling comparing open LLMs (Redwood-curated) vs smaller quantized variants. SE requested cost/latency tradeoff doc.

Routing/region notes: prefer EU region for primary traffic, fallback to NA only on overload. Concern: multi-region routing increases replication/residency complexity. Asking about per-tenant regional pinning and replica read routing.

Sales/Proc: procurement lead (Elise Dubois) is pushing for fixed monthly cap if Dedicated; finance asked for 12-mo pricing scenario. Forecasting ~70-100k ARR if Dedicated accepted.

Open technical questions: how KV cache behaves across regions, whether prefix caching can be scoped to tenant region, and details on private link/peering setup.

Next actions: send EU Dedicated config + sizing, pricing scenarios (monthly commit tiers), draft DPA, schedule infra session w/ Johan + Elise (2026-03-10 proposed).
